title: A session waiting on another session's run is not told when the run's record settles after its wait ended on a route reason
outcome: A run wait whose second resume named a retryable route reason (such as no_connection) still lets the waiting session learn the record id when the producer later settles it, even when the waiting session is not the run's owner.
acceptance: A session waiting on another session's run is not told when the run's record settles after its wait ended on a route reason is done
